decls.label: the literature right-hand side
decls.statement:
def literatureRHS (k : ℝ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  paperFT k (I / 2) + paperFT k (-I / 2)
  - ∑' n : ℕ, ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / Real.sqrt n : ℝ) : ℂ)
      * (k (Real.log n) + k (-Real.log n))
  + (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ, paperFT k r * (gammaBracket r : ℂ)

decls.label: the Gamma bracket
decls.statement: def gammaBracket (r : ℝ) : ℝ := (Complex.digamma (1 / 4 + I * r / 2)).re - Real.log π

decls.label: EF_lit (statement)
decls.statement:
def EF_lit (Z : ZeroConfig) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ 2 k → HasCompactSupport k →
    Summable (fun ρ : Z.carrier => (Z.mult ρ : ℂ) * paperFT k (gammaOf ρ)) ∧
    ∑' ρ : Z.carrier, (Z.mult ρ : ℂ) * paperFT k (gammaOf ρ) = literatureRHS k

decls.label: EF_paper (statement)
decls.statement:
def EF_paper (Z : ZeroConfig) : Prop :=
  ∀ (L : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℂ), 0 < L → ContDiff ℝ 2 f → ContDiff ℝ 2 g →
    tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2) → tsupport g ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2) →
    Z.W f g = ∫ τ : ℝ, paperFT f τ * conj (paperFT g τ) * (nuX (Real.exp L) τ : ℂ)

decls.label: ExplicitFormulaPaper (statement)
decls.statement:
def ExplicitFormulaPaper (Z : ZeroConfig) : Prop :=
  ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L → ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ 2 f → ContDiff ℝ 2 g →
    tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2) → tsupport g ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2) →
    Summable (fun ρ : Z.carrier => Z.Wsummand f g ρ) ∧
    Integrable (fun τ : ℝ => paperFT f τ * conj (paperFT g τ) * (nuX (Real.exp L) τ : ℂ)) ∧
    Z.W f g = ∫ τ : ℝ, paperFT f τ * conj (paperFT g τ) * (nuX (Real.exp L) τ : ℂ)

decls.label: EF_lit_zeta (theorem)
decls.statement: theorem EF_lit_zeta (hs : ZetaSeam) : Zeta23.EF.EF_lit (zetaZeros hs) := by

decls.label: EF_lit_zetaZeroConfig (theorem)
decls.statement: theorem EF_lit_zetaZeroConfig : Zeta23.EF.EF_lit zetaZeroConfig := EF_lit_zeta zetaSeam

decls.label: prop_EF_of_lit (bridge)
decls.statement:
theorem prop_EF_of_lit (Z : ZeroConfig) (hEF : EF_lit Z) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) {f g : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g)
    (hfs : tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2)) (hgs : tsupport g ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2))
    (hFk : Integrable (𝓕 (weilTest f g)))
    (hμ : Integrable (fun τ : ℝ => paperFT (weilTest f g) τ * (mu τ : ℂ))) :
    Summable (fun ρ : Z.carrier => Z.Wsummand f g ρ) ∧
    Integrable (fun τ : ℝ => paperFT f τ * conj (paperFT g τ) * (nuX (Real.exp L) τ : ℂ)) ∧
    Z.W f g = ∫ τ : ℝ, paperFT f τ * conj (paperFT g τ) * (nuX (Real.exp L) τ : ℂ) := by

decls.label: explicitFormulaPaper_of_lit (bridge)
decls.statement:
theorem explicitFormulaPaper_of_lit (Z : ZeroConfig) (hEF : EF_lit Z) (hΓ : GammaFacts) :
    ExplicitFormulaPaper Z := by

decls.label: the transform, paperFT
decls.statement: def paperFT (f : ℝ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ := ∫ u : ℝ, f u * Complex.exp (Complex.I * z * (u : ℂ))
